- **Edition labels:** a new page, opened from a button in the panel, that makes labels for your storage boxes. Each label shows the set icon, name and code, plus an optional FOIL mark and condition. Pick sets from your loaded CSV or from all Scryfall sets, check the exact preview and download PNG files or one ZIP for 24 mm tape.
- **Print labels directly to a Brother PT-P710BT over USB** (Chrome, Brave, Edge): connect once, then Print a label, Print all, set the number of copies and choose whether the printer cuts after each label. The page checks the tape width and explains printer problems in plain sentences. Firefox cannot print over USB, PNG and ZIP export still work there.
